name: Castorcito Base Pack
description: Sub-module of Castorcito that installs a library of ready-to-use base components (banner, card, tabs, accordion, carousel, gallery, quote, video, and more) as configuration.
project_description: Castorcito Base Pack is a sub-module of Castorcito that ships a set of ready-to-use components as configuration (castorcito_component and castorcito_category config entities) plus their Single Directory Components. Enabling it populates the component library with common building blocks — banner, card, tabs, accordion, carousel, slideshow, image gallery, content in columns, icons in columns, data number card, quote, image, video, text, announcement bar, and a placed-block component — each with its own cfields, default styling and, where needed, JavaScript behaviour. Components are meant to be cloned and adapted; their markup is overridable from a theme via the SDC replaces key.
